score_scale: Integer 1-5 per component. Higher is always better: for regulatory_safety_friction 5 = minimal friction, for failure_modes 5 = diffuse/mitigated failure modes with defined kill gates. Ranks are holistic ordinal judgments informed by component scores; no numeric totals are computed to avoid false precision.

selection.concept: Charge-buildup-immune beam current and dose metrology for ultra-high-dose-rate (FLASH) and industrial electron beams -- the traceable ammeter the field admits it lacks.
selection.decision: SELECT - a documented, published measurement failure with a cheap decisive experiment and metrology-grade moat; ranked near the bottom of the selection because the record itself caps the market at instrument scale if FLASH stalls. Chosen over near-duplicates A-08/C-10.
selection.evidence_from_candidate: Record: two independent 2024-2025 groups showed beam current transformers are corrupted by field-driven charge buildup at FLASH dose rates - an unresolved calibration/traceability problem (L05-023/024) - while ISO 11137-1:2025 tightens sterilization validation (L05-042); product adds a sterilization-QA calibration-certificate tier (merged from A-08); incumbents optimized for storage rings (Bergoz, L05-049); first experiment $150k side-by-side campaign vs Faraday cup/calorimetry; v1 $1.5-4M.

severity_and_budgeted_buyer_pain.reason: Regulators will not accept uncorrected dosimetry; device makers and sterilization operators lack traceable evidence exactly where it is demanded.

technical_feasibility.reason: Cavity charge measurement cross-calibrated to Faraday/calorimetric references is established metrology art applied to a new regime.

defensible_edge.reason: Published uncertainty budget and NIST-traceable chain in a regime incumbent catalog parts demonstrably fail.

founder_phd_adjacency.reason: $150k side-by-side campaign via university medical-physics collaborations is the stated first step - ideal doctoral-scale work.

capital_time_to_falsification.reason: $150k experiment, $1.5-4M v1 - near the cheapest in the pool.

timing_2030_2034.reason: FLASH clinical translation timing is uncertain; the industrial sterilization leg alone is steady but small.

geographic_portability.reason: US+JP; metrology instruments travel well.

regulatory_safety_friction.reason: The instrument itself is not a regulated device; customers' regulatory needs are the demand driver.

failure_modes.reason: The record concedes the honest cap: if FLASH stalls, industrial e-beam alone limits the market to tens of millions - a ceiling, not a kill.

selection.uncertainty: FLASH radiotherapy's clinical and regulatory timeline.
selection.principal_risk: Market stays instrument-scale; the company is a fine niche, not a venture-scale outcome.
selection.falsifier: Side-by-side campaign fails to demonstrate <1-2% cavity-monitor agreement with calorimetry across three orders of dose-rate magnitude where BCTs show the published errors.

selection.concept: Precision GaN pump-driver and laser-power modules: nanosecond-class programmable current drive as a merchant subsystem for industrial and defense-adjacent laser OEMs
selection.decision: SELECT - closes the shortlist with a cross-market component play on documented driver-NRE pain and named A&D demand; the two-entity export partition and OEM insourcing risk hold it at rank 24. Merged best of A-18/B-19 with diode-health telemetry and TMI-aware firmware.
selection.evidence_from_candidate: Record: laser-diode drive remains an active research area (GaN pulsed drivers, LLC modulation, ps-resolution control - L12-025/026/027) so every OEM carries driver NRE while A&D demand accelerates (nLIGHT A&D $175.3M, L12-033); CN price war (Han's high-power revenue -6.6% on +30% units, L12-037) forces outsourcing; FIX gate 2028: two PAID evaluations (one US, one CN commercial) else fold into D-10; first experiment $180k 8-channel 1kA-aggregate driver with TMI trial; v1 $5-12M.

severity_and_budgeted_buyer_pain.reason: Driver NRE is real and margin pressure documented, but OEM not-invented-here culture (record's own flag) makes the pain's purchasability uncertain.

technical_feasibility.reason: GaN driver performance targets replicate published results; TMI-aware pump-modulation firmware is the novel, plausible layer.

defensible_edge.reason: Qualified reliability data plus TMI firmware and telemetry; in-house teams and analog-semi reference designs compress the moat.

founder_phd_adjacency.reason: University fiber-laser lab TMI-mitigation demonstration and driver benchmarking are the stated pre-company steps.

capital_time_to_falsification.reason: $180k first experiment and a hard 2028 paid-evaluation gate give fast, cheap truth.

timing_2030_2034.reason: DEW scaling and CN up-market shift both land by 2030; cross-market volume is the economic logic.

geographic_portability.reason: US+CN+JP, but the mandatory day-one US(DEW)/commercial two-entity partition may force dropping one market (record's own warning).

regulatory_safety_friction.reason: ITAR segregation for the DEW line; commercial drivers low-sensitivity.

failure_modes.reason: OEM insourcing is the dominant mode; the pre-agreed fold-into-D-10 path bounds the downside.

selection.uncertainty: OEM buy-versus-build appetite for drive electronics on both sides of the market.
selection.principal_risk: Laser OEMs (IPG/Raycus/Han's in-house teams named in-record) refuse external drivers.
selection.falsifier: 2028 gate fails: fewer than two paid evaluations (one US, one CN commercial) after the 2027 8-channel/1kA TMI demonstration.
